name: Aerospace Wire & Cable Inc
old_description: Specialized Manufacturers of High-Performance Custom High-Temperature Wire & Cable Solutions
about:
Aerospace Wire & Cable Inc. was founded in 1986 in Flushing, New York. The company operates as a specialized manufacturer of high-performance custom high-temperature wire and cable solutions.

The company produces a range of wire and cable products including communication, signal, coaxial, data and low-capacitance cables, fire alarm cables, instrumentation and tray cable, thermocouple cable, RTD cable, and hook-up wire. Manufacturing processes cover extrusion through jacketing, with custom design supported by a cable worksheet. The product line spans AWG sizes from 4/0 through 30, with insulation options such as FEP, foamed FEP, ETFE, PFA, PTFE, Kapton, LS-PVC, ECTFE, PEEK, and ECA 3000. Rated voltages reach up to 1,000 volts and operating temperatures from -80°C to +300°C. The firm also maintains an inventory of UL-listed types Z, ZW, and PFAH.

Aerospace Wire & Cable serves the aerospace, appliance, fire alarm, instrumentation, and industrial sectors. Its UL AWM listings support appliance wiring applications, while its high-temperature cables are used in aerospace and industrial environments. The company also supplies standard and special designs for communication, signal, and data transmission needs.

The business emphasizes custom high-temperature cable design, a broad insulation material portfolio, and UL-listed product availability as key differentiators. It was established to provide specialized wire and cable solutions for demanding thermal and electrical requirements.
